# Composio app research: 100 apps

> Auth, self-serve vs gated, API surface, MCP, buildability verdict and evidence URLs for 100 apps, verified with a browser audit (85.8% -> 93.3% on a 20-app sample; post-loop holdout 48/48).

- [Dataset (JSON)](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/docs/results.json): one object per app, schema in spec/rubric.md
- [Dataset (CSV)](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/docs/results.csv)
- [Rubric](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/spec/rubric.md)
- [Change log](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/changelog.jsonl): every correction with reason and source
- [Gold labels](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/gold_sample.json), [holdout](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/gold_holdout_b.json)

## Headline patterns
- Most of the list is buildable today. 71 of 100 apps can become a toolkit now with credentials a developer gets alone; 22 need a review, a paid plan or a key request first; only 7 need a deal or have no public API.
- Auth is a two-lane road, not an OAuth monopoly. OAuth2 is the right primary for 50 apps and a static key or token for 45. 45 apps offer both, so a toolkit framework has to treat API keys as first-class, not as a fallback.
- Gating follows the category, not the company size. Developer, Infra and Data platforms, Productivity and Project Management are 10/10 self-serve. Ads platforms gate on app review, fintech on account approval or partnership, AI-native apps on paid plans, ecommerce on a mix: Marketing, Ads, Email and Social 5/10; Ecommerce 5/10; AI, Research and Media-native 5/10; Finance and Fintech 5/10.
- The most common blocker is a tie: app review (11) and paid plans (11). Partnership gates are rarer (6) and cluster in enterprise and fintech apps.
- Easy wins vs outreach. Of the 23 apps without a full Composio toolkit, 9 are ready to build now (LiveAgent, Vonage, systeme.io, WooCommerce, Magento (Adobe Commerce), Netlify, Binance, iPayX, Reducto); 11 need outreach or a sponsored account.
- MCP is now table stakes, but "official MCP" can mean docs search. 60 apps have a vendor MCP that can act on account data. Twilio, Mailchimp and Vonage ship MCP servers that only search their docs, and Slack’s MCP is open only to Marketplace-listed or internal apps.
